messages.author: 0c69c6d399345fab
messages.subject: Spatial Dependence Model, Hines et al. 2010
parts:
Hi All,

I'm a recent Bayesian convert, having just begun my foray into the hierarchical modeling of abundance and occupancy. I've looked through the JAGS code listed here for occupancy modeling from Marc and Michael's 2012 book:

https://www.vogelwarte.ch/assets/files/publications/BPA/BPA%20with%20JAGS.txt

I've worked through the basic single-season models and they worked great!

However,  I'm in need of some base code for the model described in Hines et al. (2010). If anyone has code in the Bugs language for this model, and is willing to share it, I'd greatly appreciate it!

Thanks,

Josh

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: RE: Spatial Dependence Model, Hines et al. 2010
parts:
Ouhhhh .... Josh,

sorry to chime in here, but I'd say that you shouldn't expect people to do all the work for you.

And especially, in my opinion, if someone finds it too hard to add covariates to a hierarchical model fit in software like JAGS, the s/he first has to get down to the basics to understand that really part of the modeling. Because if you don't, then (if you get the model to run at all), there is just far too much of a risk of fitting the wrong model (i.e., not the one you really want) or misunderstanding the meaning of the parameters.

Apologies for speaking out openly.

Best regards  -- Marc
